lines.t: Eat of me, partake of my words, and be filled
Breathe me in, that the song of the Lamb may dwell within you
For it is the knowledge of my love The revelation of who I truly am
A song, a chorus, soon to be a symphony A great outpouring of revelation
it is also the music we share
Each string plucked gently and surely
The sound of my love revealed
Bearing much fruit in the beloved
